declaring_sources.attestation_status: schemas/attestation.schema.json overall_status enum (the PASS token is read positionally, never held)
declaring_sources.maturity_floor: manifests/acceptance_matrix.yaml status_of_this_bundle (SPEC_BUNDLE floor, read not restated)
declaring_sources.signing_provenance: schemas/plugin-release-provenance.schema.json, validated by the composed epistemic_foundry.release.provenance surface

all_completion_and_external_effects_reso.mechanism: every gate emits a content-addressed receipt (receipt_id is a prefix plus sha256 of the body, receipt_hash via hash_excluding) and the sealed ZTR- verdict binds every sub-receipt by hash so it cannot be forged without reproducing each composed gate

governing_schemas_authority_boundaries_f.mechanism: the release verdict is built over the canonical attestation and plugin-release-provenance schemas, the passing status token is read positionally from the attestation enum and the provenance is validated by the sealed release-provenance surface so a reshaped schema fails closed, and the module holds no canonical enum value as a literal

happy_negative_crash_resume_adversarial_.mechanism: happy-path (unit/contract and real-artifact composition), negative and adversarial (every one of the thirteen FINDING_CODES provoked and its exact code asserted), and crash/resume is degenerate because every gate is a pure, clock-free, entropy-free function whose receipts are byte-identical on re-run

no_candidate_model_prompt_backend_or_hoo.mechanism: require_no_release_authority_capture refuses any candidate, model, prompt, backend or hook that acquires promotion, holdout or evaluator authority or binds a numeric score into a promotion decision, grounding the promotion capability in the imported registry constant

independent_review.evidence: review.md (author: parallel agent; reviewer: primary session; actor_independence between author and reviewer holds, external certification does not)
